Total Investments at fair value | amortized cost 1,750,309 | fair value 1,730,366

findings.detail: The 43.021 million BlackRock short-term investment is absent from the extracted position sum.

rationale: The extracted position sum is 1,687.339 million, which matches the filing's 1,687.345 million non-controlled/non-affiliated subtotal within 0.006 million of row rounding. The schedule then separately reports a 43.021 million BlackRock short-term investment and a 1,730.366 million grand total. Thus the 43.027 million anchor gap is explained by omission of the 43.021 million position plus rounding, rather than by a bad conservation check.
